name: clash.media-analysis
summary: Media-analysis Generator: analyze with a custom prompt for a free-form answer, or categories for typed semantic results.
rules: Generator output declarations are the sole category authority.
The analyze action accepts either prompt or categories. A prompt-only run emits description with the answer in result.text; its exact prompt is frozen by the Host.
Do not add verbatim transcript output; ASR owns transcripts.
This Generator declares semanticShape=media_analysis and must not recognize any Provider or Hilo implementation.
Importing src/stdio.ts must never start analysis or stdio serving.
